command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /etc/https-8443
install -d -m 0755 /opt/https-8443
cat > /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert <<'ANTRIEB_RENEW'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
cert_dir=/etc/https-8443
bundle="$cert_dir/tls.pem"
force=0
if [ "${1:-}" = "--force" ]; then force=1; fi
if [ "$force" -eq 0 ] && [ -s "$bundle" ] && openssl x509 -in "$bundle" -checkend 604800 -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 0
fi
exec 9>"$cert_dir/.renew.lock"
flock -x 9
if [ "$force" -eq 0 ] && [ -s "$bundle" ] && openssl x509 -in "$bundle" -checkend 604800 -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 0
fi
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$cert_dir/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
host=$(hostname -s)
ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
  -subj "/CN=$host" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$host,IP:$ip" \
  -keyout "$tmpdir/key.pem" -out "$tmpdir/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
cat "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$tmpdir/cert.pem" > "$tmpdir/tls.pem"
chmod 0600 "$tmpdir/tls.pem"
mv -f "$tmpdir/tls.pem" "$bundle"
ANTRIEB_RENEW
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert
cat > /opt/https-8443/server.py <<'ANTRIEB_PY'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import ssl
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

CERT = "/etc/https-8443/tls.pem"

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    def do_GET(self):
        body = b"HTTPS service on node1 is healthy\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

class ReloadingTLSHTTPServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True
    def get_request(self):
        sock, addr = super().get_request()
        ctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        ctx.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
        ctx.load_cert_chain(CERT)
        try:
            return ctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_side=True), addr
        except Exception:
            sock.close()
            raise

ReloadingTLSHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_PY
chmod 0755 /opt/https-8443/server.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/https-8443.service <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Certificate-reloading HTTPS service on port 8443
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/https-8443/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadOnlyPaths=/etc/https-8443

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_SERVICE
cat > /etc/systemd/system/https-8443-renew.service <<'ANTRIEB_RENEW_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Renew HTTPS certificate when fewer than 7 days remain

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/renew-https-8443-cert
ANTRIEB_RENEW_SERVICE
cat > /etc/systemd/system/https-8443-renew.timer <<'ANTRIEB_TIMER'
[Unit]
Description=Daily HTTPS certificate renewal check

[Timer]

Unit=https-8443-renew.service

[Install]

ANTRIEB_TIMER
